sections.label: Episode 1
sections.summary: Reworks the codetta (bars 12–14), with the alto's line in the soprano, the tenor's line in the bass, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: free counterpoint. Tenor: a figure from the subject, in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Bass: free counterpoint, in a sequence rising by a step every bar. Returns in Episode 2 (bars 44–46).
sections.leads: From G major to D major; perfect cadence in A minor at bar 35; perfect cadence in D major at bar 38

sections.label: Episode 2
sections.summary: Reworks Episode 1 (bars 34–38) in part, with the tenor's line in the alto, the lines moved by different intervals (invertible counterpoint at the twelfth). Soprano: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar. Alto: a figure from the subject (2 times), in a sequence falling by a step every half bar.
sections.leads: Between two statements in D major

sections.label: Episode 3

sections.leads: From D major to E minor; perfect cadence in G major at bar 54
